shell: Create an ORIGINAL Minecraft Mekanism induction-casing-inspired STRUCTURAL TEXTURE ATLAS. Four exact equal square tiles in a 2x2 grid edge to edge with NO gutters or margins. This is flat pixel-art production texture artwork, not a perspective object illustration. Every tile will be resized to 16x16; use the simplicity of exactly 16x16 large flat square cells, only 6 neutral gray colors plus 1 tiny subdued violet detail. Top left: plain light-gray load-bearing frame face, mostly broad off-white steel center, continuous medium-gray 1-pixel rim and four simple 1-pixel corner bolts. NO middle stripe, vents, panels inside panels, inset screens or lines crossing the center. Top right: formed version of EXACTLY this frame with identical geometry, corner bolts subtly violet-gray. Bottom left: very plain white-gray armor panel, huge empty center, one 1-pixel recessed border and no bolts. Bottom right: formed version of exactly the armor, identical geometry with just two tiny muted lilac corner pixels. All tiles rotationally balanced, can be used identically for ceiling, wall and floor. 90% light neutral gray. No black central stripe, no decorative circuitry, no repeated long violet lines, no grunge, fine noise, gradients, bevel rendering, glow, bloom, writing or perspective. These tiles will repeat across a large 7x7x7 Minecraft multiblock: at distance the structure must read as calm broad white-steel beams, not a busy machine wall. Opaque square atlas.
orb: Create an ORIGINAL Minecraft industrial sci-fi material texture atlas for a floating GRAVITATIONAL ENERGY SPHERE with two thin metal containment rings. FLAT MATERIALS ONLY, do not draw a sphere or machine or any object. Exact edge-to-edge equal 2x2 atlas, no gaps or margins, all 4 squares opaque. Every square must have the simplicity of exactly 16x16 large flat pixel cells. Top-left material: dark violet energy surface for a UV-mapped low-poly sphere, sparse broad angular bands of graphite purple and muted purple, black-purple predominant but clearly visible purple, no stars, tiny dots, crackle, ornaments or circles. Broad asymmetrical 3-to-5-pixel-wide color areas, restrained industrial sci-fi energy. Top-right material: plain light steel for thin orbital containment rings, three broad horizontal tones of neutral gray across the full tile, calm and mostly light gray, no bolts or details. Bottom-left material: graphite metal material for the inner surface of those thin steel rings, two broad charcoal gray horizontal bands, no patterns. Bottom-right material: ACTIVE ENERGY version of top-left, EXACT SAME broad angular pattern but violet areas brighter with two broad muted lavender streaks; keep most of the surface dark purple and avoid white highlights, neon pink, gradient or bloom. At 16x16 the artwork must remain sparse and clear. Flat pixel materials, no perspective, no labels, no objects, no black circular cavity, no brackets or casing, no celestial sky, no glowing haze. Square canvas.
